fields.subject: SQL Server Type Mapping
fields.trigger: a compiled table-valued-parameter row mapper builds the row-expression for a property mapped with MapToSqlJsonAttribute
fields.response: throw a NotImplementedException reporting that the Json data type is not implemented in ADO.NET for table-valued functions
fields.postcondition: no table-valued-parameter row expression is produced for a Json-mapped property; every other MapToSql*Attribute variant contributes a row expression instead

sources.label: every other MapToSql*Attribute variant's AppendTvpExpressions delegates to a TvpExpressionHelpers builder instead of throwing (22 overrides spanning this range; only the Json variant at 1308-1310 throws)
